title.narrative: Accelerating Innovations for Energy Efficiency Initiative

description.narrative: The project aims to improve energy efficiency, particularly in the industry, transportation, and green building sectors in Viet Nam, via increasing investments in innovative business solutions through start-ups, in alignment with VNEEP3 and the National Green Growth Strategy (VGGS).The main beneficiaries of the project are the Ministry of Industry and Trade (MOIT) including its relevant departments, start-ups with energy efficiency solutions, and other stakeholders in the Viet Nam start-up ecosystems. Direct support is channeled to accelerate 20-30 start-ups (“product-market fit”) and youth groups (“idea-product fit”) with innovative business solutions on energy efficiency in target sectors. Moreover training for an estimated 100 lecturers and trainers in relevant academia fields will be rolled out.

Viet Nam is one of the most energy-intensive countries in East 798. To support the Viet Nam - National Energy Efficiency Program (VNEEP3) which was set up by the government of Viet Nam to address this challenge, the European Union Delegation to Vietnam (EUD) and GGGI kicked off the “Accelerating Innovative Start-ups for Energy Efficiency” (AIS4EE) program in 2022. The project focuses on accelerating innovation and market development of the energy efficiency (EE) sector, with the following key components:· Increasing investments in innovative business solutions to start-ups in EE for industry, transportation, and green building through the implementation of an acceleration program.· Improving innovative ecosystem for start-ups in energy efficiency in the long term through (i) training of trainers and building a network of start-up ecosystem stakeholders in energy efficiency; (ii) capacity building for potential EE start-up founders and investors and (iii) raising awareness for the public at large.
